nodes.label: Scoped commitment clarification
nodes.rationale: Use offered matching commitments instead of guessing the target from recent conversation.

nodes.label: Scoped owner activity labels
nodes.rationale: Observed apps, inferred categories and owner-reported tasks have different authority and expiration.

nodes.label: Context-specific prediction feedback
nodes.rationale: Definite verdicts adjust predictions in their original app/time context; uncertainty remains pending and feedback grants no action permission.

nodes.label: Native taskbar parenting
nodes.rationale: Place the widget only in a measured safe gap and reconnect after Explorer recreation without shell injection.

nodes.label: Durable Telegram inbox
nodes.rationale: Persist received updates before acknowledging offsets; report uncertain interrupted executions instead of replaying possible side effects.

nodes.label: Shared cognitive evidence
nodes.rationale: Reuse provenance-bearing episodes, durable inquiry budgets and event wakeups while retaining local execution authority.

nodes.label: Proposed verifiable application adapters
nodes.rationale: Expand execution through supported adapters with persistent state and verified results rather than treating an idea as permission.

nodes.label: ADR-019 proposal-only executive review
nodes.rationale: Shared evidence and observable outcomes justify extending existing durable review boundaries instead of continuously polling an unrestricted model.

nodes.label: ADR-018 observation-only recovery
nodes.rationale: Desktop operations cannot be rolled back by SQLite; reconcile uncertain effects by observation rather than blind resubmission.

nodes.label: Visible screen observation badge
nodes.rationale: Observations require a visible connected badge and stop for idle or locked sessions.

nodes.label: Specified verified artifact publication
nodes.rationale: Atomic no-overwrite publication and saved input hashes permit recovery without accepting stale or conflicting artifacts.

nodes.label: Specified finite external-action claims
nodes.rationale: Run desktop effects outside database transactions with exclusive claims, then reconcile uncertainty by observation.

nodes.label: AI language and local thinking specification
Specified local-only cognitive review
nodes.rationale: Language may use configured OpenRouter with Ollama fallback, while cognitive and notification review cannot spill into cloud inference.

nodes.label: Specified review and interruption gates
nodes.rationale: Permission for silent review and permission to interrupt differ; hard quiet or busy gates remain authoritative.

nodes.label: Specified event-driven attention wakeup
nodes.rationale: Meaningful events wake existing durable review; reconciliation timers do not mandate speech or authorize tools.

nodes.label: Runtime mode and Spotify status specification
Specified factual saved-connection status
nodes.rationale: Saved OAuth login is distinct from online playback verification; failed reads must clear stale status claims.

nodes.label: Specified shared temporal situation snapshot
nodes.rationale: Conversation, inquiry and notifications share dated interpretations without treating overdue commitments as completed or silently modifying schedules.
